name: Mixpanel
description: Mixpanel describes itself as "the product intelligence platform for the AI era," combining analytics, session replay, experiments, feature flags, and AI-powered insights.
best_for: Positioned for product, data, marketing, and engineering teams — from startups to enterprises across SaaS, ecommerce, media, healthcare, and finance — who want fast, data-driven product decisions without needing SQL.
features: Product and web analytics with fast querying
Metric Trees for hierarchical metric organization
Warehouse/CDP connectors and headless/programmatic data access

alternatives.name: Amplitude
alternatives.description: A product analytics platform bringing AI into product-building, with experimentation and feature management.
alternatives.best_for: Product, data, and engineering teams needing product analytics with feature experimentation.

alternatives.name: Heap
alternatives.description: A product analytics platform that automatically captures every user interaction without manual event tagging.
alternatives.best_for: Product teams wanting automatic data capture for conversion and retention analysis.

pricing.starting_price: Free up to 1M events/month; Growth starts at $0 and scales with event volume

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Unlimited seats; up to 1M events/month, 10K session replays/month, 1K MEU/month for experiments, and 10 active feature flags.

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.notes: Starts at $0 with the first 1M events free, then scales by event volume up to 20M events/month. The pricing calculator shows different annual and monthly rates at higher volumes.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Contact sales; supports up to 1T events/month with custom replay, experimentation, retention, alerts, and dedicated support.

cons: Free is capped at 1M events per month and 10K session replays; higher event or replay volumes require Growth or Enterprise.
Growth pricing is usage-based after the free event allowance, so the displayed cost changes with annual event volume and billing term rather than staying at a flat subscription price.
Several advanced monitoring, data-management, and enterprise-support capabilities are reserved for higher tiers or sold as add-ons.
